key: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they, seeing with their eyes, and hearing with their ears, and understanding with their heart, return, and be healed.’
s: Sent in the throne vision, the prophet is charged to harden the people until their land lies waste; Rashi, on 6:10, reads the hardening as their own doing, refusing to hear the prophets for fear they might understand, repent and be cured.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, Isaiah 6:10, at [339,10]). Plain sense faithful: 6:1 to 8 the throne vision and the prophet sent, 6:9 to 10 the charge, 6:11 the land utterly waste; no four-word repeat of the key. Rashi on 6:10 reads השמן as a continuing process (their heart grows ever fatter, their ears ever heavier), and on ‘lest they see’ says they set their hearts not to hear the prophets, fearing His words would please them and they would understand, return to Me, and be cured; his 6:11 gloss (until when will they make their heart heavy) agrees. The reading (their own doing; refusing the prophets for fear of understanding, returning and cure) is carried by these words; ‘repent’ renders וישובו fairly. Ibn Ezra takes the forms as imperatives the prophet declares, a difference the entry need not name. Entry passes entry-check.
